subject: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the conversation earlier this week. To keep momentum, can we lock a 45–60 minute vendor kickoff next week that covers: procurement checklist, security intake owners, and a short 20-minute technical demo for Lumina engineers? Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 11/24 09:30–10:30
- Wed 11/25 10:00–11:00
- Thu 11/26 13:00–14:00

Agenda (attached): kickoff overview, procurement steps & docs, security questionnaire timeline, demo (SE), next steps & mutual action plan.

Attendees from our side: me (AE), Karthik (sales lead), Diego (solutions engineer), Monica (Customer Success) — Monica will join the kickoff and later onboarding checkpoints.

If you prefer, we can split procurement and security into two shorter sessions — please advise. I’ve attached a draft agenda and procurement checklist to help procurement triage.

Attachments: Redwood_Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf; Procurement_Checklist.xlsx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Tom Ellis <procurement@luminahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@luminahealth.com>, Jasmine Wu <jasmine.wu@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist

Laura —

Thanks — quick note on availability: we are out Thursday for a company holiday. Tue 11/24 won't work (team busy with quarterly close). Wed 11/25 10:00–11:00 looks best for procurement + eng (Alyssa will attend), but Jasmine (security) prefers to do the security questionnaire review the following week so her team has time to pull artifacts.

Also can you confirm:
- What artifacts you typically provide up front (SOC2, encryption architecture, dataflow diagrams).
- Who will own the procurement SOW draft and DocuSign routing (our legal prefers vendors to initiate).

If Wednesday works for Redwood, we’ll treat that as the kickoff and book a separate deep-dive with security on Mon 11/30 or Tue 12/1.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Senior Procurement Manager
LuminaHealth
procurement@luminahealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <procurement@luminahealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist

Tom —

Wed 11/25 10:00–11:00 confirmed from our side; I’ll hold the slot and Laura will send the calendar invite. Quick answers to your asks:

- Artifacts: we’ll share a SOC2-summary (high level), an encryption & dataflow diagram, and a standard security questionnaire (we’ve included the SOC2-summary.pdf in the attachments). Full reports and network diagrams can be provided under an NDA if needed.
- SOW & DocuSign: Redwood usually shares the initial SOW template; we can create the DocuSign envelope and route it to the Lumina legal contacts once procurement confirms terms.

Proposed kickoff agenda (short):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 15m — Procurement checklist & timeline (Laura + Karthik)
3) 20m — Technical demo (Diego) + Q/A
4) 5m — Next steps & mutual action items (Monica added for onboarding handoff)

I’ve attached a one-pager procurement checklist; Laura, Monica — can you add any onboarding touches?

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Wu <jasmine.wu@luminahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist

Hi all —

Thanks for the coordination. A couple of security items before kickoff:

- Please attach the completed vendor security questionnaire if you can; alternatively, point me to a shared folder.
- We’ll need evidence of SOC2 or a summary of controls (noted you have a summary).
- Can the SE include a brief diagram of where tokens and logs live and how long caches/retention behave? That will determine whether we need a separate session to review retention & logging controls with our infra team.

If it helps, our preference is to review the questionnaire asynchronously before the live session; then use the kickoff for alignment and the demo. If there are outstanding artifacts, we’ll book the security deep-dive on 11/30 09:30–10:15 or 12/1 14:00–14:45 PST.

Jasmine Wu
Senior Information Security Engineer
LuminaHealth

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Wu <jasmine.wu@luminahealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: kickoff + demo & procurement checklist

Jasmine —

Happy to cover the dataflow and token/kv cache behavior in the demo. I’ve attached a one-page diagram (high level) and a short note on retention defaults. If you prefer the asynchronous route, I can drop the questionnaire answers into the Drive folder by EOD 11/24 so you can triage before the meeting.

Attachments: dataflow_diagram.png; retention_notes.txt

For the deep-dive, 11/30 09:30–10:15 PST works for our infra engineer; I’ll pencil that in as a tentative.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <procurement@luminahealth.com>, Jasmine Wu <jasmine.wu@luminahealth.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: LuminaHealth vendor kickoff — Wed 11/25 10:00–11:00 PST

Thanks everyone — slot confirmed for Wed 11/25 10:00–11:00 PST. I’ve sent the calendar invite to the attendees and shared a Drive folder with the attached artifacts: SOC2-summary.pdf, Redwood_Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf, Procurement_Checklist.xlsx, and Diego’s dataflow_diagram.png.

Action items before kickoff:
- Redwood: upload completed security questionnaire answers to the Drive folder by EOD 11/24 (Diego).
- Lumina: confirm legal contact for DocuSign routing (Tom).
- Redwood: prepare initial SOW draft and will share via DocuSign after the kickoff (Karthik).

Security deep-dive tentatively scheduled for Tue 11/30 09:30–10:15 PST — we’ll finalize in the kickoff.

Looking forward — quick run of show will be circulated in the invite.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
